conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings. Expect lower volatility but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce overall leverage and meet the combined leveraged ETF mandate.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality tech name. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to cure the concentration flag.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It embraces higher leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups. Be aware of significantly higher drawdown potential and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs; strict stop discipline is paramount.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield.
